scope: Prospective per-user next-character personalization; Study D and Study Q do not qualify as natural-text personalization corpora.

corpus_requirements.source: consented participant-authored text or participant-confirmed decoded text collected before evaluation
corpus_requirements.timestamp_policy: sort by timestamp when available; otherwise preserve the participant-supplied document order
corpus_requirements.anonymization: remove names, email addresses, phone numbers, and user-selected sensitive spans before local storage; keep participant ID pseudonymous

available_data_audit.study_q: typed grid-key labels; five repeated task phrases per subject; not conventional natural language and too small for personalization evaluation
available_data_audit.study_d: fixed prompted task text; not user-authored history suitable for prospective personalization
available_data_audit.development_corpora: Four author-labelled public-domain sources prepared for software debugging only; no participant inference.

secondary: learning curve by bank token count

current_gate.g2_language_gain: public-domain smoke benchmark is development-only; participant claim pending
current_gate.g2_simulator_validation: failed D known-result check: absolute accuracy error 0.179 exceeds locked tolerance 0.05; Q check passed
current_gate.decision: G2 no-go for live use; RAG remains implemented but unproven. Participant offline evaluation may still be reported when consented text is available.

natural_text_development_benchmark.corpora: public-domain Project Gutenberg works by Jane Austen, Mary Shelley, Herman Melville, plus the existing Arthur Conan Doyle excerpt
natural_text_development_benchmark.split: chronological prefix (60% bank), following 20% for training-only gate selection, final 20% evaluation; cap at 4,000 whitespace tokens per author
natural_text_development_benchmark.topic_switch: Austen-bank to held-out Moby-Dick text, development-only cross-author shift
natural_text_development_benchmark.sample_note: Capped software smoke sample for runtime and pipeline debugging only; not an inferential language benchmark.

analysis_preregistration.primary_metric: mean next-character negative log likelihood in nats on eligible grid characters
analysis_preregistration.primary_correction: Holm correction across the three paired participant-level comparisons

secondary_metrics.true_character_rank: mean rank and mean reciprocal rank
secondary_metrics.keystroke_savings: fraction of held-out characters whose true key appears in the top-3 suggestions

analysis_preregistration.secondary_correction: Holm across three RAG comparisons times three secondary metric families
analysis_preregistration.unit_of_inference: participant; token-level metric aggregation is within participant
analysis_preregistration.participant_bootstrap: 95% percentile CI resampling participants with replacement
analysis_preregistration.gate_tuning: sufficiency, confidence, and backoff thresholds selected using only the first 80% of the chronological training portion (60% overall fit, next 20% tune); the final 20% remains untouched until the locked evaluation
analysis_preregistration.topic_switch: train-bank topic A; report the first 100 eligible characters after a switch to topic B separately; no retuning after switch
analysis_preregistration.online_adaptation: teacher-forced updates from decoded prefix only; score each next key before update; test cold-start and cumulative updates

participant_text_collection_protocol.sample_definition: one participant-provided, naturally authored text sample in the language used for the speller, with a documented date range and topical source
participant_text_collection_protocol.collection: participant transfers a local UTF-8 text export or types a selected natural-text sample; no cloud upload required
participant_text_collection_protocol.minimum_inclusion: 700 whitespace tokens total, yielding at least 420 bank-training, 140 gate-tuning, and 140 held-out tokens after chronological 60/20/20 split
participant_text_collection_protocol.storage: pseudonymous local-only files; never commit source text or phrase banks
participant_text_collection_protocol.live_bank: build from the 60% bank-training portion; fit gates on the following 20%; freeze before session; never seed from held-out 20%
participant_text_collection_protocol.timestamped_input: accept UTF-8 text or JSONL records containing timestamp and text; order by timestamp when present, otherwise preserve document order
participant_text_collection_protocol.anonymization_minimum: remove email addresses and phone numbers automatically; require participant-selected review/redaction of names and sensitive spans before analysis
